parameters.query: SELECT ticket_id, user_email, issue, category, priority, status, created_at FROM tickets WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at DESC

parameters.jsCode:
const stats = $('Aggregate Stats').item.json;
const llmText = $input.item.json.text || '';
const insights = llmText.trim() || 'AI insights unavailable — please review the data manually.';

const lines = [
  'Daily Support Ticket Digest',
  '='.repeat(42),
  `Date: ${stats.date}`,
  '',
  '── Summary ──────────────────────────────',
  `Total Tickets:    ${stats.total}`,
  `Open:             ${stats.open}`,
  `Resolved:         ${stats.resolved}`,
  '',
  '── By Priority ──────────────────────────',
  `High:             ${stats.by_priority.high}`,
  `Medium:           ${stats.by_priority.medium}`,
  `Low:              ${stats.by_priority.low}`,
  '',
  `Top Category:     ${stats.top_category}`,
  '',
  '── AI Insights ──────────────────────────',
  insights,
  '',
  '─'.repeat(42),
  'Full history tracked in Google Sheets.'
].join('\n');

return [{
  json: {
    date: stats.date,
    total: stats.total,
    high: stats.by_priority.high,
    medium: stats.by_priority.medium,
    low: stats.by_priority.low,
    open: stats.open,
    resolved: stats.resolved,
    top_category: stats.top_category,
    email_body: lines,
    subject: `Daily Ticket Digest — ${stats.date} (${stats.total} tickets)`
  }
}];
